# Adhd

This folder contains the two primary course-based demographic cohorts tracked within the Danish ADHD-DATABASEN: the treatment population and the diagnostic (assessment) population. These cohorts serve as the foundational denominators for national quality indicators, monitoring everything from pharmacological treatment coverage and psychoeducation initiation to long-term educational outcomes like primary school exam pass rates. The pages detail the demographic distributions, regional variations, and systemic challenges associated with each phase of the ADHD care pathway in Denmark.

## Pages

- [[adhd-behandlingspopulation|ADHD-behandlingspopulation]] — The national cohort of individuals who have entered an ADHD treatment package course, serving as the baseline for measuring medical treatment, psychoeducation, and educational outcomes.
- [[adhd-udredningspopulation|ADHD-udredningspopulation]] — The national cohort of individuals who have undergone an ADHD diagnostic assessment, used to monitor somatic diagnostics, early cross-sectoral coordination, and youth educational achievements.
